title: Single-Actuator Lab Manifest
description: RESEARCH-ONLY input packet for one single-actuator lab capture. Implies NO production entity, route, or Mongo collection. The manifest is the CAPABILITY LOCK: `actuator_lock` names exactly one actuator and `call_budget` is 1, and the harness refuses anything else rather than filtering it into apparent success.

run_id.description: Run directory name. `capture` refuses to overwrite a frozen run; a re-capture needs a new id.

why.description: What this capture is FOR. Prose, read by a human in review.md.

actuator_lock.description: EXACTLY ONE actuator name, from the production capability table. Not a list: a list is a thing someone widens.

call_budget.description: Const 1 in v1. A later manifest version may change it EXPLICITLY; nothing may raise it at runtime.

source.description: v1 admits local checksummed fixtures only. Nothing is fetched; a remote source would need a new enum member AND a recorded provenance, deliberately.

sha256.description: Checked BEFORE the run and again after. A mismatch aborts; it never proceeds with a note.

prompt.description: The user's words, unchanged. Required for prompt_orchestrated; null is legal only for the direct control modes.

control_phrase.description: The explicit phrase handed to the organ. Required for organ_direct and actuator_direct; in prompt_orchestrated it is the PAIRED control the extracted phrase is compared against, never a substitute for it.

allowed_params.description: Param keys the lab will pass through. Intersected with the production actuator's declared `param_keys`; the intersection wins, so a manifest cannot widen the actuator.

warm_or_cold.description: cold unloads the model first, so the receipt measures a real cold start rather than inheriting a resident predictor.

repeat_count.description: Repeats of the SAME locked call, for stability. Each repeat is its own budgeted invocation and every one is recorded.

deterministic_framer.description: Arm C only. A frozen prompt→phrase mapping instead of a live planner. The trace SAYS it did this; it is never a silent substitute for an unavailable model.

expected_condition.description: positive: the concept is visibly present. negative: known absent, an empty result is the PASS. adversarial: expected to expose concept-binding limits, not to produce a trusted result. open: nobody knows, which is a legitimate state for a lab.

protocol.description: How semantic correctness would be established. `none_required` does not mean 'assume correct' — it means the capture makes no semantic claim at all.

questions.description: What the reviewer is asked, written into review.md.

pair_with.description: run_id of the paired control. This is what turns two runs into an attribution: same image, control phrase vs full prompt.
